bill.constitutionalAuthorityStatementText:
[Congressional Record Volume 172, Number 161 (Thursday, October 15, 2026)]
[House]
From the Congressional Record Online through the Government Publishing Office [www.gpo.gov]
By Mr. HARRIGAN:
H.R. 10822.
Congress has the power to enact this legislation pursuant
to the following:
Clause 1 of section 8 of article I of the Constitution;
Clause 3 of section 8 of article I of the Constitution.
[Page H6046]

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, and in addition to the Committee on the Judiciary, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.
